svg.text: 1. MATERIAL: ASTM A36 PLATE, .375 THK. QTY 2 —
IDENTICAL PLATES, MATCHED ROTARY DAMPER PAIR.
2. ALL FEATURES CNC WATERJET CUT THRU MATERIAL.
3. OPERATION: PLATES STACKED FACE-TO-FACE ON COMMON
HUB PIVOT. ROTATING TOP PLATE 36.0° MOVES EVERY
HOLE ONTO SOLID WEB = FULL SHUTOFF. FLOW IS
4. SEALING RULE: WEB ≥ 1.5×Ø IN EACH ROW (C-C ≥ 2.5×Ø).
CLOSED-POSITION SEAL COVER .354 MIN, VERIFIED OVER
ALL HOLE PAIRS. RADIAL WEB 2.250 (1.5× ROW-2 Ø).
5. 10 HOLES ON 5 RADIAL SPOKES × 2 ROWS; DIA PER ROW
PER TABLE. SAME COUNT PER ROW REQUIRED SO BOTH
ROWS CLOSE AT ONE TWIST ANGLE.
6. OPEN AREA (ALIGNED) 71.7 SQ IN = 15.8% OF GROSS.
KERF COMP BY SHOP. THIS PRINT GOVERNS DIMS.
DEBURR BOTH FACES — PLATES MUST ROTATE FLUSH.
ANGLES CCW FROM +X AXIS. ROW RADII TO HOLE CENTERS.
EVERY HOLE ON SOLID WEB, .354 MIN COVER
